snippet.title: Edge of Memories | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a gorgeous anime world on the brink of despair. As the corrosion spreads across the land, permanently scarring the landscape.

Fight back against this corruption in Edge of Memories, coming to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2026.
